notes: All figures are period-end (fiscal year end) common shares issued and outstanding, as reported at the time, with no retroactive split adjustments. FY1994-FY2008 are taken directly from balance sheets in SEC EDGAR 10-K filings (CIK 0000320193); FY1992 from the FY1994 10-K's shareholders' equity statement (thousands precision). FY1981-FY1991 predate EDGAR (Apple's first electronic filing was Jan 1994); those figures come from Apple's own annual-report financial statements as reproduced verbatim in period accounting/strategy textbooks and casebooks digitized on archive.org, with multi-source and net-income/retained-earnings chain cross-checks. Precision: FY1984, FY1985, FY1987, FY1991, FY1993-FY2008 are exact to the share; FY1981-FY1983, FY1988-FY1990, FY1992 are as published in equity statements in thousands of shares (max rounding error 500 shares). FY1986 is the one derived value: the FY1987 balance sheet's 1986 comparative (125,255,226) was restated for the June 1987 2:1 split, so the as-reported figure is exactly half (62,627,613); it divides evenly, but treat that year with slightly lower confidence since no direct FY1986-report reproduction was found. Sanity anchors all matched: FY1997 127.9M, FY2000 335.7M, FY2005 835.0M, FY2008 888.3M. Note that 10-K cover-page counts (e.g., 161,158,987 as of Dec 10, 1999) are dated 6-11 weeks after fiscal year end and intentionally NOT used where balance-sheet figures were available. Splits during the period: 2:1 June 1987, 2:1 June 2000, 2:1 Feb 2005 (visible as level shifts in FY1987, FY2000, FY2005).
